about.title: About Me
paras: A self-taught software engineer and technologist based in London. Passionate about turning complex ideas into robust, user-centric products. With hands-on experience handling the full lifecycle of web and mobile projects, I thrive in environments where technology and creativity meet real business needs.

I have a pragmatic approach, always seeking straightforward, maintainable solutions to real problems. Whether I'm building from scratch or improving existing systems, I enjoy breaking down challenges and crafting clear, elegant solutions that feel intuitive to use and perform reliably at scale.

timeline.title: Developer Technologist @ Eklipx
bullets: Designed, developed and launched a real-time risk and trade management dashboard. It's fully customizable with various widgets enabling risk based decisions and easy book management.
Architected and built an article view tracking system. Alongside this delivered an analytics screen for authors summary metrics and time series graphs to dive deeper into the data.
Underpinned by the article view tracking, I developed automated revenue share calculations, with Stripe for author payouts and dynamic PDF reporting for admins in the front end.
Architected and built an agnostic audit event logging package used internally for our products.
Introduced a Cypress end-to-end test suite covering all critical user flows for our Intelligence product. Integrated into Azure to run on PRs into main, preventing bugs in production.
Overhaul of all transactional emails using a single base template component for the purposes of consistency and maintainability.

timeline.title: Full Stack Developer @ We Are Sweet
bullets: Developed front-end for industry first second-screen experience used by PTO. Winning the 2024 ISC Innovation Award. The web experience handles multiple real-time updates per second while maintaining optimal performance.
Ensured cross-platform compatibility and optimal performance across mobile and desktop devices to maintain accessibility for diverse user base.
Built real-time race logistics management system integrating RFID chip timing and GPS data to deliver superior accuracy and reliability over multi-day events compared to competitor solutions.
Maintained and developed new features for the Concerts for Carers website and ticket balloting system.
Contributed to AWS infrastructure development with focus on security and scalability to support high-volume live data processing.

timeline.title: Front End Developer @ Engine Creative
bullets: Developed 3D & AR product viewer enabling users to visualise products in their own space before purchasing. Used by companies such as Samsung, Invisalign, Dell, HP and Ultimaker.
Designed white-label solution with customizable branding, allowing easy adaptation of color schemes and logos for different client requirements.
Integrated advanced 3D/AR rendering and interaction capabilities to create immersive product preview experiences that enhanced user engagement.
Led complete project lifecycle from concept to deployment as sole developer, managing all aspects of development, testing, and client delivery.
